item.description:
## whispermax v0.1.3
- better speech detection for silence, short recordings, and noisy rooms - accessibility is now optional, with clipboard fallback still working - clearer pasted vs copied feedback across browsers, native apps, and electron apps - transcript history now shows where text was pasted - history retention setting for keeping the latest 100, 500, or 1000 transcripts - refreshed app icon, sidebar mark, and menu bar icon - more reliable model download retries and safer local storage cleanup
